transcript.text: Maradona picks it up on the left channel, two defenders closing in.
He slows the play down, shoulders dropped, waiting for the challenge.
Oh, a drop of the shoulder — the defender is completely wrong-footed!
Maradona bursts into the space, only one man between him and the goal.
Another feint inside the box — the second defender commits and loses.
He gets the shot away! Vintage Maradona, pure balance and deception.
The crowd is on its feet. That is the body feint, executed to perfection.

events.title: Receiving under pressure
events.analysis: Maradona takes the ball on the half-turn in the left channel. Body shape already side-on, giving him the option to go either way — the setup every feint needs.

events.title: Tempo manipulation
events.analysis: He decelerates deliberately. Slowing the defender's momentum is the real weapon here — a static defender is easier to unbalance than a moving one.

events.title: Body feint — shoulder drop
events.analysis: The signature move the CV pipeline flagged: full shoulder and hip dip left, ball goes right. No step-overs, no touch at all — pure body deception. Defender's weight is entirely on the wrong leg.

events.title: Explosive acceleration into space
events.analysis: The feint only works because of what follows: first three steps at full sprint before the defender can re-set. Separation of two metres created in under a second.

events.title: Second feint in the box
events.analysis: Repeat of the same pattern inside the penalty area — defender now over-commits trying to block the shot. CV confidence dips here (occlusion), so the second-vote disagreement between the VLMs is expected.

events.title: Shot release
events.analysis: Low centre of gravity lets him strike while still moving away from goal. Coaching note: the feint created the angle; the balance finished the job.
